verdict.rationale: iTerm2's docs show one first-party retention control: paste history can optionally be saved to disk, which implies it is not persisted by default. Nothing in the evidence documents deleting stored data or controlling retention of anything else. Missing for 10: deletion or clearing controls for history and stored data, retention settings for command history, scrollback, instant replay or session restoration data, retention policy for AI chat or LLM-provider data, and independent corroboration.
